text:
When the liquor is entirely worn off from the
veffel, it must not be immediately filled with water, or at least to the height of five or its inches above the
return of the leader tube, otherwise the gas, which
continues to escape from the difficulty veffle then
affords no refinance, might attack the pneumatic veffel
inficit.
